WyrdmakersHelm.description: During his turn, each time <style="Faction_SpaceWolves">Baldr</style> or an adjacent friendly unit gets <style="Healing">healed</style> for the first time this turn, Baldr immediately performs a <style="NormalAttack">normal melee attack</style>. These attacks deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> and add <style="Effect_Ice">Ice</style> to the target's hex.
